dimensions.label: Product intent
dimensions.why_not_higher: Native end-to-end interaction evidence is incomplete.

subchecks.label: Fable 5.1 surface model is preserved
subchecks.deduction_reason: No unsupported page or hard-coded Needs Me surface is present.
subchecks.recommendation: Keep the current product model unchanged.

dimensions.label: Information architecture and interaction
dimensions.why_not_higher: The donor's shell-level controls are not exposed in the current title strip.

subchecks.label: Shell actions are discoverable
subchecks.deduction_reason: Sidebar/focus/panel/eject/HUD actions exist through shortcuts or panel-local controls but are missing from the main strip shown by the donor.
subchecks.recommendation: Mount a compact donor-style toolbar in the existing main chrome using the existing actions.

dimensions.label: System craft and visual fidelity
dimensions.why_not_higher: Settings titles do not consistently match the donor, and HUD proof is incomplete.

subchecks.label: Settings heading anatomy matches donor
subchecks.deduction_reason: Appearance has no page heading; Providers, Capabilities, Context, and General use a large title-case heading instead of the donor's compact tracked uppercase title.
subchecks.recommendation: Use one donor-style settings title class and add the missing Appearance title; leave Voice unchanged because it matches the donor.

subchecks.label: Agents editor and team anatomy match donor
subchecks.deduction_reason: Rendered editor structure, density, and styling closely match; populated current cards and team sheet were not natively captured.
subchecks.recommendation: Re-capture populated native states after macOS is unlocked.

subchecks.label: HUD and ejected panel visually match donor
subchecks.deduction_reason: Current browser capture has the wrong native window geometry; live donor HUD capture was blank.
subchecks.recommendation: Capture current native ejected and HUD windows beside the donor reference after unlock.

blockers.impact: The required screen-for-screen fidelity claim cannot yet be made for populated Agents, live messages, ejected panel, or HUD.
blockers.required_action: Unlock macOS and run a native round-two capture of the missing states.
